parameters.template: <twig:Sw:Form:Checkbox name="acceptedDataProtection" label="I have read the data protection information." validationRules="required" />

name.description: Name attribute of the checkbox. Required.

id.description: Id of the checkbox. The label, description and feedback element are derived from it.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for checkboxes that have no visible label. Ignored when `label` is set.

value.description: Value submitted when the checkbox is checked.

description.description: Hint below the field. Linked to the checkbox via aria-describedby.

variant.description: Renders the checkbox as a Bootstrap switch.

validationRules.description: Comma separated list of client-side validation rules, rendered as data-validation.

violationPath.description: Key the server-side violations of this field are stored under.

violationLabel.description: Field name used in server-side violation messages instead of the property path.

formViolations.description: ConstraintViolationException holding the server-side violations of the request. Defaults to the `formViolations` Twig global; pass it explicitly to render a field outside a request scope.

required.description: Renders the required marker and aria-required.

additionalClass.description: Additional classes on the form-group wrapper. Migration alias for the `class` attribute on the component tag; both are merged.

additionalInputClass.description: Additional classes on the checkbox. Migration alias for the `control:class` attribute; both are merged.

args.name: acceptedDataProtection
args.label: I have read the data protection information.
